opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that deliver outstanding quality teaching in fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: Supports specialist arts institutions to provide training opportunities for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions (not university departments) that can demonstrate outstanding teaching in fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per year for undergraduate and postgraduate students in the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post, hold a doctorate, and are based at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who are UK residents and have held a teaching/research post at a UK university or eligible research institute.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each (total up to £50 million)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (or consortia of up to two) with research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds up to 30 interdisciplinary doctoral scholarships (plus related master‑plus‑PhD routes, post‑doctoral opportunities and programme administration).

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (single or collaborative centres).
opportunities.summary: Supports large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences, employed at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Provides two‑ or three‑year fellowships for original research in the humanities and social sciences.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers with a UK university post that extends beyond the fellowship, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers, particularly those whose teaching/administrative duties have limited their research time.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) and at least two years post‑PhD experience.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a research team and develop research leadership.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes/organisations).
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative original research projects up to five years, with a focus on fundamental research.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff who will host an eminent senior professor from overseas; host institution must have research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits of eminent overseas scholars to enhance skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.
